title: รักษารากฟัน คืออะไร? ทำยังไง? ดีไหม?
ttsPrompt: Narrate as a warm, friendly, clear Thai health-explainer narrator in a reassuring documentary style. Speak fluently at a natural pace (~14 Thai characters per second) with crisp articulation and brief natural breaths between clauses. NEVER whisper, NEVER use ASMR breathiness, maintain full clear voice from the very first word. Pronounce Thai and dental terms cleanly and naturally.
